alex: Uploaded a quick quant benchmark for marlin-70b across APAC(H100), EU(Hopper2) and NA(A100). INT8/FP8/FP16/BF16 compared. Link: https://s3.redwood/test-artifacts/marlin70b/1928123456.tar.gz TL;DR: APAC H100 INT8 gives ~1.8x tokens/s vs FP16 but ~0.9% pass@1 drop on our synth eval; EU Hopper2 FP8 looks near-parity with FP16 after nightly qcalibration. Details below.

maya: Nice — can you paste the p50/p95 latency and tokens/s numbers here?

alex: Sure — quick paste: 
- APAC H100 INT8: p50=12.2ms, p95=32.8ms, tokens/s=2800
- APAC H100 FP16: p50=20.5ms, p95=45.1ms, tokens/s=1550
- EU Hopper2 FP8: p50=18.1ms, p95=40.2ms, tokens/s=1720
- EU Hopper2 FP16: p50=17.9ms, p95=39.4ms, tokens/s=1685
- NA A100 INT8: p50=15.9ms, p95=41.0ms, tokens/s=2100
Notes: seq=1024, batch=8, single-GPU. Driver: CUDA 12.1 unless noted.

sam: Which eval metrics did you use? ppl/rouge/human?

alex: Eval set = "synth_bb_2k" (2k prompts). Metrics: perplexity (ppl), pass@1 human rating, and a lightweight hallucination flag. Highlights: APAC H100 INT8 -> ppl +0.8, pass@1 -0.9% (stat sig at p<0.05). FP8 on Hopper2 -> ppl -0.1, pass@1 +0.1% (noise). INT8 hallucination increased on >1k token prompts (low-temp sampling).

jin: Did you test cache warmup + batching? p95 often dominated by KV misses.

alex: Yes. With prefix/KV cache warm (simulated mem hit) p95 for INT8 drops ~10-12%. Batching: batch=16 -> throughput +35% but p95 increases ~1.8x. Auto-batcher in this run: `smart-batcher-v1`. We also tried `burst-batcher` for latency-sensitive routes.

rachel: Any kernel differences worth flagging? We've seen fused kernels behave oddly on older drivers.

alex: Good call. On A100 the runtime picked `matmul-optimized` for INT8 which was slower. For A100 switch to `fused-attn-compat` to gain ~+12%. On H100/Hopper2 `fused-attn-v2` is best for INT8/FP8. CUDA 12.3 improved FP8 perf ~3-5% on Hopper2 in our smoke runs.

alex: Quick reproducible command we ran:
``` 
./bench --model marlin-70b --profile int8 --kernel fused-attn-v2 --seq 1024 --batch 8 --region apac --warmup 200
```
Replace `--profile fp8` or `--profile fp16` for other runs.

bench-bot: Benchmark artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/apac-eu/marlin70b/1928123456.tar.gz :white_check_mark:

maya: Recommendation? Are we ready to flip defaults anywhere?

alex: Proposal:
- APAC (H100): enable INT8 only for non-safety-critical production routes with automatic FP16 fallback when pass@1 drop >0.5% per-route eval.
- EU (Hopper2): enable FP8 as default for marlin-70b with nightly qcalibration; FP8 gave near-parity and good cost savings.
- NA (A100): keep FP16 default; allow INT8 opt-in with kernel override `fused-attn-compat` and upgraded driver.
I'll add per-route eval alerts (pass@1 drop, ppl delta) and a canary rollout config.

sam: Can you add cost estimate ($/1M tokens) for each profile?

alex: Rough estimate: H100 INT8 ~42% lower $/token vs FP16; FP8 ~28% lower. Exact numbers in artifact (cost_table.csv). Will follow up with a short doc for rollout ops.

alex: Action items: 1) I will upload detailed CSVs and kernel flags (done), 2) eng-platform to add per-route eval alert, 3) infra to test driver 12.3 on EU hopper2 staging.

maya: Thanks, this helps a lot. :thumbsup:
